notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check; the evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every run and is not part of the package. The package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 and unreviewed (reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached, native.py was never imported or run, and no EPICS Soft IOC was contacted. The clone at 8bcf1e54511791b0f20ce1dc4d15a8cd6cc47eff was only read and its git status is clean. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names helper PythonObjectDriver; one measurement selects one of four native Channel components from an input, which a fixed PythonObjectDriver command path cannot express, so the package is a decorated direct Driver over the confirmed entry symbol sophys.common.devices.compacteras:CompactERAS (the card's direct-driver decision is unchanged). The other four card entry symbols exist in the clone but are different devices, and one package serves one device. Scope: read-only state (version, supported_devices and the voltage and current of CH1 to CH4) and cap.measure.voltage.v1 plus cap.measure.current.v1, each selecting the optional channel input. No MHS Limit is declared: the four channel names are the class components and are enforced as a device precondition (MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET) before any read, not as a safety envelope. R0 read-only: CompactERAS declares no stop, abort, disable or acquisition command, so there is no native @estop and no independent hardware stop claim; an e-stop is the endpoint's software latch and safe_state records that the device is unchanged. NOT COVERED: the writable Channel/Scale members (measurement_type, the offsets, voltage_full_scale, voltage_scale_factor and the Scale calibration settings) because the clone states no range or safe value for them; verifyVersion as a command; and every hardware behaviour. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording and not an upstream simulator (the clone ships no CompactERAS simulator); every value and reply in fake.py is marked placeholder and none is a Fact, a Limit or a citation. G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is the expected warning for a read-only package that declares no limit on an actuating capability; every other MHS-Sim CL3 test passed and no G4 warning was reported.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model source review checked every Fact, the four read-only CompactERAS channels, native factory, LGPL-3.0 provenance, omitted card entries and the R0 latch-only scope. fake.py incorrectly rejected an incompatible version, although compacteras.py:117-142 logs a warning and returns True after a successful read; fake.py now follows that behaviour and test_driver.py adds a regression case. facts.md now describes that connectivity-check behaviour accurately and check-report.json was refreshed. All seven package-specific cases, the full fake gate including G9, and the strict collector pass; the only gate note is the expected read-only G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE. For the human reviewer: This model decision covers only read-only CompactERAS measurements; no upstream import, IOC, network or hardware was exercised. The other card entries ControllableMotor, AravisDetector, Pimega and Mobipix are separate physical devices and are not served. Writable Channel/Scale calibration members remain outside this package. The fake supplies placeholder data and does not establish EPICS timing, connection quality, measurement accuracy or hardware safety; reviewed_by remains null.
